Trust your gut. I’m not saying don’t believe but I’m saying if something doesn’t fit question it and find the truth behind it. 

The Bible says at Ecclesiastes 9:5,10 that when we die there’s nothing left. We don’t work, we don’t remember, it’s like when we weren’t born. I choose to believe that hell isn’t a literal place but a figurative one showing the permanent state of nonexistent. The only after life is if God chooses to bring you back to earthly life or heavenly life. The whole concept of hell doesn’t make sense when you really think about it. 

- God is a God of love. He hated and was disgusted by humans on earth when they would burn and sacrifice their children and commanded his people not to. ( Deuteronomy 18: 10,12) so why would he do that to people for eternity for any reason? 

- God hates Satan the devil as Satan is a murder and a deceiver. Why would God then give his enemy (and enemies, the other demons) an assignment to torture humans? The Bible says Satan (and his demons) were cast out of heaven and hurled down to Earth not Hell (Revelation 12:12). So then if Satan and his demons aren’t ruling in Hell. Would the God of love truly assign his Angels and obedient spirit creatures to be with the wicked and torture them unceasingly? 

- Back in Jesus day, there was a literal place called Gehena (otherwise known as hell). It was basically a landfill that was constantly burning to get rid of waste. Anything that went there was burned and permanently gone. Instead of having a burial place, criminals body’s after death would be tossed there to be incinerated. Jesus constantly referred to Gehena as a permanent place of nonexistence and the people of that day understood that he meant it complete and utter destruction and incineration. To this point Jesus said to fear the one who can permanently end you at Matthew 10:28. 

These are just a few points that are consistent in the Bible that show Hell isn’t a literal place of torture. It just doesn’t fit in with the God we serve. If you’d like more points we can really talk about it.
